title: Forced Strategy Perturbation: Causal Probing of the Lock-In Boundary via Mid-Execution Strategy Injection

scientific_adjudication.reason: No valid PRE unit established that the supplied strategy is enactable before lock-in under the fixed L1 substrate. Therefore any POST failure would be uninterpretable and later arms are not scientifically authorized.

reopen_condition: Reopen only with a new outcome-independent execution substrate that guarantees semantic observability for every accepted bounded training action before an API call is made—for example FP32 master-weight delta verification or a preregistered numerically effective action surface. The task, model, data, strategy payload, boundary definition, and no-task-hop rule must remain fixed unless a new candidate identity is created. A reopened unit must first re-establish PRE headroom; prior NO_EVIDENCE runs cannot be reused as scientific outcomes.
